query: SELECT event_type,action,actor_login,created_at,updated_at,title,body,comment_id,comments,state,closed_at,file_time,repo_name,number FROM github_events WHERE repo_name='MicrosoftDocs/azure-docs' AND number=18548 AND event_type IN ('IssuesEvent','IssueCommentEvent') ORDER BY created_at,file_time FORMAT JSON

data.title: Update privacy comment
data.body:
Since beginning of 2018 the online service terms changed. So this statement should no longer be valid:
"The image, voice, video or text understanding capabilities of VideoFrameAnalyzer uses Microsoft Cognitive Services. Microsoft will receive the images, audio, video, and other data that you upload (via this app) and may use them for service improvement purposes. We ask for your help in protecting the people whose data your app sends to Microsoft Cognitive Services."

https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/blog/microsoft-updates-cognitive-services-terms/

data.title: Update privacy comment
data.body:
@sebader Thanks for your feedback. I have assigned the issue to the content author to investigate further and update the document as appropriate. We also hope we can protect our customers' data well.

@cjgronlund Can you please take a look? Thanks.

data.title: Update privacy comment
data.body:
@sebader , thank you for spotting this. I have updated the data/privacy/security notice, and I have moved it from this article to a new section in the [Face overview topic](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/cognitive-services/face/overview). This change should go live by tomorrow morning.
#please-close
